0.original: Oul Sigun thirsts for your kindness.

25.original: Give the water to the leafmen.

48.original: Mortal, mortal, hear my plea! Our precious children are thirsty, and I need you to bring them water.

49.original: Who are our children, you ask? Why, they're the leafmen you see standing about our village. Adorable, aren't they?

50.original: Now, you'll need to go to Longmirror Lake to draw the water. Once you have it, see that our children have a good drenching.

51.original: Oh, but be warned: the Fuath make their home in the lake. They tend to play rough, so have care!

52.original: They may look alike to strangers, but to us each of our children is unique and special!

54.original: You want water? We'll give you a lungful!

55.original: You've given water to our children? Thank you ever so much!

56.original: They're all very dear to us. They wandered into Il Mheg as stray mortals, but we grew attached to them and decided to take them in.

57.original: You and yours would've been our children too, but the enchantment didn't catch as well as we'd hoped. It's never too late of course...
